column1: # BASH-VERIFIED lexer vectors (omega PR #336 review fixes). Columns, TAB separated: id, input, expect, equiv.
# input/equiv escapes: \n \t \\ \xHH. expect: "ok" then space separated tokens (W:<text> with \x20 for a space;
# PIPE OR AND SEMI NL; LT:fd GT:fd APPEND:fd DUPO:fd DUPI:fd) or "refuse CODE@OFFSET". Word text is the bash view:
# backslash-newline removed, quotes removed. equiv: "-" means the script rendered from the ok tokens; otherwise the
# continuation-free script bash must treat identically to the input. bash_verify.sh runs real bash 5.2 on both.

ok W:e W:a PIPE W:e W:b NL
ok W:e W:a NL W:e W:b NL
